title: Stability, Auth and QA Hardening
notes: Hardened workspace and session resolution so temporary backend failures no longer masquerade as disconnected accounts.
Added self-healing isolated test accounts and complete internal role switching for owner, admin, supervisor, dispatcher, safety, mechanic and accounting QA.
Expanded production browser QA for deep links, reloads, hamburger navigation, browser and Android-style back history, sign-out, role isolation and notification routing.
